decisions.label: clear
decisions.evidence: When you share or recommend any TED.com content using your Facebook profile, your action is governed by Facebook's privacy policy. Likewise, when you share or recommend any TED.com content through other social media outlets, your actions are governed by their privacy policies.
decisions.rationale: The policy mentions that actions are governed by the respective social media privacy policies, which typically do not specify a limited retention period, implying indefinite retention.
